facility.name: Mi Casa Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8601 CINNAMON CREEK DR, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78240

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One of the ten files reviewed had documentation indicating that the child had a diagnosed food allergy. There was not an allergy action plan on file for the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two of the ten children's files reviewed did not have current immunization records included in the files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three of the ten children's files did not include current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A hot glue gun was found to be plugged in with the cord accessible to children, posing the potential for a risk of injury to the children.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the glue gun was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination: A record of a Pest Control company providing services was not available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Record of Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.801(17))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The two school age groups were observed eating their lunch and watching movies.   Noted: this was corrected during inspection when the screen time requirements were reviewed and the televisions were turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: During the investigation, it was identified that the operational policies lacked a component: procedures for supporting inclusive services for children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: It was determined through the investigation process that caregivers were using the prohibited punishment of yelling as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual without an active background check was present at the operation. Noted: This was corrected when the individual was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In a room with a specified age group of two years, there was 12 children with one caregiver.   Noted: this was corrected when a child was transitioned to another room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Through the investigation process, it was determined that supervision was compromised when a child was unaccounted for a period of 45 seconds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who ceased employment in 2023 by the   required date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: Two classrooms had activity plans posted for the week of Oct. 30-Nov 3.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A child was seated in a high chair and was not utilizing the strap. Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the child was fastened in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Classrooms were left out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Parents were not notified of minor injuries to their children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: In one of the classrooms, a fan was found on top of a kitchen play structure.   Noted: This was corrected at inspection when the fan was removed from the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: An individual no longer employed at the operation is still active on the people list.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the person was made inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An employee was present and had been inactivated on people's list.    This was corrected during inspection when employee was sent home and advised they must not return until results are returned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three of ten children's records did not include a healthcare statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The two transportation vans were observed without electronic child safety alarms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))
